title: podophyllum hexandrum var. bhootanense
intro: Podophyllum hexandrum var. bhootanense, commonly known as Himalayan may apple, is a variant of the Podophyllum hexandrum plant, a species of flowering plant in the barberry family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, anti-cancer, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include lignans, podophyllotoxin, and podophyllinic acid, among others. The bioactive constituents of Himalayan may apple are responsible for its potential health benefits, including the inhibition of cancer cell growth and the modulation of immune response.
